plugins.name: instrument
plugins.description: Instrument cluster for ZCode model replies: a session-sidebar panel with per-reply first-token latency, generation speed, token usage, reply history, model comparison, tool time and failure stats — plus a /metrics command and a metrics tool.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 模型回复仪表盘：本轮/会话双视角、时间构成、上下文、回复列表、模型对比、健康度，以及 CommandCode 订阅额度（5h/周/月）。

plugins.author: Yedou
